text:
Rules for every question:
- Ask for a metric by name when one fits; write SQL only when
  none does, and say which.
- Money is DECIMAL dollars. *_date columns are the depot's
  calendar; *_at columns are UTC moments.
- Orders and order lines are placed and not cancelled; there is
  no status column to filter on.
- Join a fact to a dimension on its *_key. A fact's account_key
  is the account's version on the fact's day; for today's
  attributes use dim_account WHERE is_current.
- Ratios are ratios of sums, never averages of rows.

Metrics (name: meaning; may be broken down by):
- revenue: Quantity times the price charged after the line's
    discount, over lines of orders placed and not cancelled, dated
    by the depot's local date. Equals the ledger's sales journal
    to the cent. By: region, segment, channel, category.
- orders: Orders placed and not cancelled, dated by the depot's
    local date. An order is one row however many lines it has. By:
    region, segment, channel.
- gross_margin: Revenue less the cost of the goods, each line
    costed at the price list in force on the order's day. By:
    region, segment, channel, category.
- margin_pct: Gross margin as a percentage of the revenue of the
    lines that have a cost. A ratio of sums, never an average of
    percentages. By: region, segment, channel, category.
- active_accounts: Accounts with a contract in force at the month
    end. Not accounts that ordered lately, and not accounts the
    CRM marks active: those are different questions, with
    different names. By: region, segment.
- not_renewed_rate: Of the contracts that ended in the period, the
    percentage that were not renewed. Dated by the contract's last
    day; a contract still in force has no outcome and is not
    counted. By: region, segment.
- portal_conversion: Of the portal's sessions, the percentage that
    submitted an order. Bot sessions are left out. Submitted
    orders include ones later cancelled, so they will not match
    the orders metric. By: region.

Tables (grain; columns, with notes where needed):
marts.dim_date: One row per calendar day, 2021-01-01 to
    2026-12-31.
  date_key INTEGER (20251231), date DATE, year SMALLINT, quarter
    TINYINT, month TINYINT, month_name VARCHAR, day_of_month
    TINYINT, day_of_year SMALLINT, day_of_week TINYINT (1 Monday
    ... 7 Sunday), day_name VARCHAR, is_weekend BOOLEAN,
    is_working_day BOOLEAN (Monday to Friday),
    working_day_of_month TINYINT (NULL at weekends), iso_year
    SMALLINT, iso_week TINYINT, week_start DATE (the Monday),
    month_start DATE, month_end DATE, is_month_end BOOLEAN,
    fiscal_year SMALLINT (named for the year it ends),
    fiscal_quarter TINYINT, fiscal_month TINYINT
marts.dim_region: One row per region.
  region_key VARCHAR, region_id SMALLINT, region_name VARCHAR
    (Midwest | Northeast | Southeast | Southwest | Unknown |
    West), region_code VARCHAR (the ledger's code: NE, SE ...; --
    | MW | NE | SE | SW | WE), depot VARCHAR (Atlanta | Columbus |
    Dallas | Newark | Sacramento | Unknown), timezone VARCHAR (the
    depot's calendar; America/Chicago | America/Los_Angeles |
    America/New_York | UTC)
marts.dim_supplier: One row per supplier on procurement's list.
  supplier_key VARCHAR, supplier_id SMALLINT, supplier_name
    VARCHAR (procurement's spelling), country VARCHAR (-- | CN |
    DE | MX | US), tier VARCHAR (Approved | Preferred | Strategic
    | Unknown)
marts.dim_product: One row per SKU per cost version.
  product_key VARCHAR, sku VARCHAR, product_name VARCHAR, category
    VARCHAR (Cleaning | Facilities | Packaging | Safety |
    Sanitation | Unknown), supplier_key VARCHAR, list_price
    DECIMAL(18,2), unit_cost DECIMAL(18,2), valid_from DATE,
    valid_to DATE (NULL: still current), is_current BOOLEAN
marts.dim_account: One row per account per version.
  account_key VARCHAR, account_id INTEGER (the portal's account),
    account_name VARCHAR, region_key VARCHAR, segment VARCHAR
    (Enterprise | Mid-market | Public sector | Small business |
    Unknown), owner VARCHAR, status VARCHAR (active | closed |
    unknown), key_account BOOLEAN, customer_since DATE, closed_on
    DATE, postcode VARCHAR (text: it has leading zeros),
    valid_from DATE, valid_to DATE (NULL: still current),
    is_current BOOLEAN
marts.fct_order_lines: One row per line of a placed, not-cancelled
    order.
  order_id BIGINT, line_no SMALLINT, order_number BIGINT
    (degenerate dimension), date_key INTEGER (the depot's date),
    account_key VARCHAR (version of that day), product_key VARCHAR
    (cost of that day), supplier_key VARCHAR, region_key VARCHAR,
    channel VARCHAR (Field sales | Partner | Telesales | Web),
    placed_at TIMESTAMP (UTC), order_date DATE (the depot's date),
    qty INTEGER, discount_pct SMALLINT, unit_price DECIMAL(18,2)
    (after discount), unit_cost DECIMAL(18,2), revenue
    DECIMAL(18,2) (qty * unit_price), cost DECIMAL(18,2) (qty *
    unit_cost), gross_margin DECIMAL(18,2) (revenue - cost)
marts.fct_orders: One row per placed, not-cancelled order.
  order_id BIGINT, order_number BIGINT, date_key INTEGER,
    account_key VARCHAR, region_key VARCHAR, channel VARCHAR
    (Field sales | Partner | Telesales | Web), placed_at
    TIMESTAMP, order_date DATE, line_count SMALLINT, units
    INTEGER, revenue DECIMAL(18,2), cost DECIMAL(18,2),
    gross_margin DECIMAL(18,2)
marts.fct_tickets: One row per ticket, from opened to closed.
  ticket_id VARCHAR, account_key VARCHAR (NULL: not a customer),
    region_key VARCHAR, product_key VARCHAR (when a SKU is named),
    opened_date_key INTEGER, first_reply_date_key INTEGER,
    solved_date_key INTEGER, closed_date_key INTEGER, opened_at
    TIMESTAMP, first_reply_at TIMESTAMP, solved_at TIMESTAMP,
    closed_at TIMESTAMP, channel VARCHAR (email | voice | web),
    category VARCHAR (account | billing | delivery | quality |
    returns | stock), priority VARCHAR (high | low | normal |
    urgent), desk VARCHAR (north_desk | south_desk), status
    VARCHAR (as of the last load; closed | open | solved),
    comment_count SMALLINT, hours_to_first_reply DECIMAL(10,2),
    hours_to_solve DECIMAL(10,2)
marts.fct_contracts: One row per contract.
  contract_id INTEGER, account_key VARCHAR (version valid at
    start), region_key VARCHAR, start_date_key INTEGER,
    end_date_key INTEGER, notice_date_key INTEGER, start_date
    DATE, end_date DATE, term_months SMALLINT, legacy_terms
    BOOLEAN, discount_pct SMALLINT, outcome VARCHAR (NULL: not yet
    ended; not_renewed | renewed), cancellation_reason VARCHAR
    (Budget cuts | Business closed | Consolidated suppliers |
    Moved to a competitor on price | Product quality | Service and
    delivery problems)
marts.fct_contract_month: One row per contract per month end it is
    in force.
  contract_id INTEGER, month_end_date_key INTEGER, account_key
    VARCHAR (version valid that day), region_key VARCHAR,
    month_end DATE, months_in_force SMALLINT (1 in its first
    month), months_remaining SMALLINT (0 in its last month),
    discount_pct SMALLINT, contracts_in_force TINYINT
marts.fct_portal_sessions: One row per portal session.
  session_id VARCHAR, account_key VARCHAR, region_key VARCHAR,
    date_key INTEGER (the depot's date), started_at TIMESTAMP,
    ended_at TIMESTAMP, device VARCHAR (desktop | mobile),
    event_count INTEGER, searches INTEGER, product_views INTEGER,
    add_to_carts INTEGER, checkouts_started INTEGER,
    orders_submitted INTEGER, account_id INTEGER (the portal's
    account), is_bot BOOLEAN (a script, not a person: leave out),
    late_events INTEGER (events that arrived after the row was
    written), clock_offset_s INTEGER (seconds the device's clock
    was corrected)
